newsitem.title: FRANCE: French, German operators in Retevision deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: French, German operators in Retevision deal - paper.

text.p: France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom are likely to join bank Banco Central Hispano and electricity group Endesa to bid for shares in privatisation candidate Retevision, the Les Echos newspaper. Retevision is Spain's second largest telecoms operator.

"The negotiations are advanced," a BVH spokesman was quoted as saying. The groups could form a consortium as soon as this week. According to Spain's Expansion, France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom could take a total 35 percent stake in Retevision.
"The aim of France Telecom is to be an overall competitor to Telefonica, in Spain and in South America," les Echos quoted Patrick Teixido, managing director of France Telecom Spain, as saying.

The Spanish government is expected to approve a privatisation framework for Retevision in the coming weeks with the sale of some shares in early 1997. The company is expected to be fully privatised by the year 2000.
